en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 4.Faḍālah narrated from ʿUmar ibn Abān who said, “I heard a righteous servant (ʿAbd Ṣāliḥ)[1] say
regarding the inmates of Hell [who are released after their punishment], ‘They are made to enter the Fire due to their sins, and they come out therefrom through the pardon of Allah.’”
